title: The minutes have been circulated
body: The minutes of this month's meeting record an action against your name. Nobody remembers agreeing it, including the person who wrote it down. It is due on Friday.

title: Your figures have been presented
body: Priya has shown your figures to the floor above, with one small improvement: Priya's name is now in the corner where yours was. An email thanks the team for its support.

title: FW: Monthly Status Report OVERDUE
body: Dennis has forwarded you a chaser about the report you did not file while you were at the pub with Dennis. The whole message reads: Thoughts?

title: Thanks for your input
body: Your Monthly Status Report has gone upstairs under Dennis's name, as an executive summary of your Monthly Status Report. The summary is your report.

title: You hear your phrase on the way up
body: Dennis is explaining strategic patience to someone from the fifth floor, and is doing so as its author. You are holding the door.

title: Your desk has been moved
body: As part of the Workplace Refresh, your desk is now next to the printer, and has no window. Somebody has been given the one with the window, and nobody will say who decided.

title: Your project is apparently in trouble
body: Someone from another team asks kindly how you are coping. You did not know that you were coping with anything. It seems to be widely known that your project is in trouble.

title: RE: The figures you needed by Tuesday
body: Callum has sent you the figures you needed. It is Wednesday. Callum's message adds that they are sorry for the delay, and that the whole team has been copied in, along with your deadline.

title: Invitation updated
body: A meeting you were preparing for has moved to yesterday. The minutes are attached. You were present, and you agreed to several things.

title: Those laptops
body: Priya has told several people that you promised the team new laptops. You did not. You have now been asked when they will arrive, by someone who does not believe you.

from: From: Hugh Lamb, Head of Operations
title: A small favour
body: Hugh has put you on a working group about working groups, on the basis of a conversation you do not remember. It meets on Fridays, and it has no end date.
